newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh interbank market shut due to strike.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh interbank market shut due to strike.

text.p: A nation-wide strike by Islamic groups in Bangladesh on Tuesday forced the country's interbank market to shut, dealers said.

The strike was called to protest against an Israeli Jewish woman who put up posters two weeks ago portraying the Prophet Mohammad as a pig. "Most dealers remain absent. The market is virtually shut," said one dealer.
Nearly 90 percent of the nation's 120 million people are Moslems.
The Bangladesh taka closed at 43.7650/7700 to the dollar in interbank trading on Monday.
